newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks firm ahead of Christmas.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks firm ahead of Christmas.

text.p: Croatian stocks, reawakened by fully-listed Pliva pharmaceuticals and Zagrebacka Banka, closed firmer on Tuesday in relatively brisk pre-holiday trade.
* All of four traded issues rose.
* Volume lower at 4,270 shares, turnover 14.3 million kuna.
* Most active Zagrebacka Banka was also top gainer, rising 4.90 percent to 1,070 kuna with 2,506 units sold.
* Pliva up 2.94 percent to 14,000 kuna on volume of 819.
The Zagreb bourse will be closed for Christmas, reopening for a full-day's trade on Friday. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
